lokele: Imi Paulo oyatomu lioi ndoyala Botomomu wa Masiya Yesu ko la lisangi lia Mungu, la etungani ya Etanda ako Sosetene,
english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ 1:1 through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

lokele: tosotoma liseeli liasu end’eba Etanda ya Mungu eyayali nda Kolinto end’ebasüchomo ko ende Masiya Yesu, ebatomu lioi lioyalaka ebatanu amamwito la batotina ebatosingwaka lina lia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya nda bilela bitotina, Ngɛnɛ wau la ewasu lisanga;
english: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

lokele: tosotomel’ino bootaota la lilatemi lia Mungu Sango wasu la elia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Isofaekefa Mungu kelekëlë eoka yanu ko mbile bitotina loasɔ loa booto wa Mungu ebosofomo ino nda liwatemani lanu la Masiya Yesu,
english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

lokele: la eoka mbo osofotesomo nda beyaeli bitotina ko lande, la nda liekesi la nda liluwani,
english: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

lokele: l’ani inango sha Yesu siakɔkɔmɛsɔmɔkɔ end’ino;
english: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

lokele: ongoma ino angolengeela lofo angolɔmɔi loa bafi ba Bolimo, ani atolombakelak’ino lɔɛnɛsɔ loa Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya,
english: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

lokele: ako Inde oyatokɔkɔmɛsɛ ino ko nda liko, ani oti la litwanelo nda lise lina lia Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya.
english: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Mungu ale wolendelomo, end’Inde oyasot’ino lioi ndosangana la Wana wande ako Yesu Masiya Ngɛnɛ wasu. Loasɔ loa liwesani lia eba Etanda
english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

lokele: Bitungani yami, isömb’ino to ko la lina lia Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya, mbo bokulianeke ino batotina la mbo bawesani batayala sisi yanu, kangä mbo bowachaneke la nda baenyeli la nda likomyi lia njasɔ yanu.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, 1:10 through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

lokele: Eoka, bitungani yami, bamɔi ba Kuloe basokambesa’mi fololo mbo ino wende la besho.
english: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

lokele: Imi mbo boto la boto wanu atoonga mbo— Imi yende ewa Paulo. Bamɔi mbo— Nde imi yende wa Apolo; ango ko mbo— Imi ewa Kefa; ango ko mbo— Imi ewa Masiya.
english: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

lokele: ¿Mbo Yesu asoatana? ¿Mbo Paulo aolomokö nda lieka eoka yanu? ¿La walufiomokö nda lina lia Paulo?
english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

lokele: Isofa Mungu kelekëlë mbo itilufieke boto angɔmɔi wanu sakolo ko Kelisipo la Gayo kongo,
english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

lokele: mbo boto ataonga mbo osolufiomo ko la eliami lina liko Paulo.
english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

lokele: (Ambo yalufiakä imɔ ko eba bofindi wa Setefano; nde itiluwe kwa mbo isolufia wasi.)
english: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

lokele: Eoka Masiya atitomeke’mi ndolufia bato, kangä ndonangoel’iyo Mboli Ilau; la inga to la wɛlï wa lioi mbo lieka lia Masiya litayala ko liyaëlä wawa. Litina lia Lieka lia Masiya la wɛlï wa Mungu
english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

lokele: Eoka lioi lia linangoli lia lieka liende ko ebebe ende ebakosɛɛsɛlɛ, kongo ko end’iso ebasouwesomo liende bofoka wa Mungu.
english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

lokele: Losotomo to nda Lokasa mbo— Itosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ wɛlï w’ebale la wɛlï, la itosɛɔlɔ liluwani lia eba elälä.
english: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.” Isaiah 29:14

lokele: ¿Ewa wɛlï ende to ndai? ¿Botikasa wa Bikela ende ndai? ¿Boto wa ngwasu ende to ndai? ¿Mungu aisotombola wɛlï wa wenda eoka wende ko ebebe?
english: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

lokele: Eoka ya wɛli wa Mungu to, eba wenda angoluwa Mungu ko la mboka ya wɛli, limɔ Mungu lɔɛnɛ mbo bolau ndouwekesa ebasoimela ko la mboka ya bibebe ya linangoli.
english: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

lokele: BaYuda to nd’atofelaka ndembe ya bisisho; BaHela nd’atolukaka wɛlï,
english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

lokele: kongo ko iso nd’asonangola Masiya oyaolomökö nda lieka; ende BaYuda liende ko sɔni finɛ, ende BaHela la eba wenda, liende ko ebebe;
english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

lokele: kongo ko ende ebasotomo lioi, la BaYuda la BaHela, Masiya ende ko bofoka wa Mungu la wɛli wa Mungu.
english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

lokele: Eoka ebebe ya Mungu esolongela wɛlï wa balomboki fwaa la botembu wa Mungu bosolongela bofoka wa balomboki.
english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

lokele: Bitungani yami, ɛnɛkɛ to, lotomo loanu lioi ende Masiya, mbo bamyɔ kongo ba wɛlï wa bato basotomo lioi, ko bamyɔ kongo ba bofoka, ko bamyɔ kongo bende bana ba bato b’isosha;
english: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

lokele: kongo ko Mungu asoaa bibebe ya wenda-bo mbo atomboleke eba wɛlï, la Mungu asoaa bilɛli ya wenda-bo mbo atomboleke eba bofoka;
english: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

lokele: Mungu asoaa mbuwa ya wenda-bo la twao etoti ango la litina, etoti ango yeka mbo asɛlɛkɛ yao ko wawa ko lau ebayali,
english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

lokele: ongoma angwɛnɛ bolomboki koomakala nda baiso ba Mungu.
english: that no flesh should boast before God.

lokele: Nde ino wende bana bande ko eoka ya Yesu Masiya oyasoya wɛli wa Mungu end’iso, oyasoeshel’iso liengani la litanesi la liendoli;
english: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,

lokele: ongoma to kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Oyatoomala, aomaleke ko l’eoka ya Ngɛnɛ.
english: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.” Jeremiah 9:24

lokele: Nde ayaka’mi end’ino, bitungani, itiayaka la baoi b’isosha sifi angoko ba wɛli bonangoel’ino inango sha wewe sha Mungu,
english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

lokele: eoka yasangaka mbo imi angoluwa loasɔ loasi lonangoel’ino sakolo ngo ko eloa Yesu Masiya la liwa liande nda lieka.
english: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

lokele: Nde imi nd’ayaka end’ino la bɔlɛmbu wa bindo, la bɔwa la liwangi finɛ;
english: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

lokele: ongoma lioi liami la inango shami sitiayalaka la baoi boimelomo wimelaimela, kangä baoi bɔɛnɛsɛ ino Bolimo la bofoka wa Mungu,
english: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

lokele: mbo lilendelu lianu litalendelo wɛlï wa bato kangä bofoka wa Mungu.
english: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

lokele: Totoonga ndoonga to njasɔ ya wɛlï ende batowange nda liimeli, nde boti wɛlï wa wenda-bo ango ewa bakakalesi ba wenda-bo ebelasɛɛsɛlɛkɛ;
english: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

lokele: kongo ko totoonga loasɔ loa wɛlï wa Mungu angɛnɛ ebotiaaka woongomo oso, ewaisomökö kwala, ewasangak’Inde likomyi osooso, ko oso wa wenda, mbo aiyesek’iso nda tala yande.
english: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

lokele: Angwɛnɛ angɔmɔi wa bakakalesi ba wenda-bo nd’aluwaka wao, eoka eyambo baluwa ani batiaolaka Ngɛnɛ wa Tala nda lieka;
english: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

lokele: kongo ko kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Liso likɛni, litoi likoki, botema wa bolomboki bokaenyeli Njasɔ ebisokomya Mungu eoka ya ebatosamaka Inde,
english: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.” Isaiah 64:4

lokele: nde Mungu asoisoel’iso yao ko la Bolimo eoka Bolimo atɔɛlɛlɛ mbo aluweke bitotina, imɔ ko eya Mungu ebiisomu mbii.
english: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

lokele: ¿Boni oto nd’aluwi baenyeli ba oto sakolo ko bolimo wa boto nd’atiteni yande angɛnɛ? Ko ongoma angwɛnɛ nd’aluwi baenyeli ba Mungu, sakolo ko Bolimo wa Mungu.
english: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.

lokele: Iso totiaɔlɔkɔ̈ to bolimo wa wenda-bo, kangä Bolimo wa Mungu mbo toluweke yao ina ebiafaefomoko iso ko la Mungu,
english: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

lokele: yao ina ebitonangol’iso, inga to ko nda baoi boekesomo ko la wɛlï wa bato angɛnɛ, kangä eboekesomoko la Bolimo wa Mungu, la nda liekesi ndokweela eya Bolimo ende ebasɛɛli Bolimo.
english: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

lokele: Bolomboki angɛnɛ angolembeela to njasɔ eyafaefomoko ko la Bolimo wa Mungu eoka end’inde bende ko bibebe, la atikɔkɔlɛ ndoluwa yao eoka bitolembeelomo ko la lisungi lia Bolimo kongo.
english: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

lokele: Nde boto oyasosungomo la Bolimo atolembeela boyaeli wa bitotina, nde inde angɛnɛ atikɔtɔlɔmɔ la boto angɔmɔi.
english: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

lokele: ¿Ndai to aluwi baenyeli ba Ngɛnɛ, ndai kotwa lande kuko? (Yesaya 40, 13) Iso nd’aluwi to baenyeli ba Masiya.
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” Isaiah 40:13 But we have Christ’s mind.

lokele: Nde, Bitungani yami, itikɔkɔlɛkɛ ndoonga lanu kwa atoonga’mi la bato ebasoluwana la Bolimo, kangä kwa mbo wende balomboki kongo, ango ko kwa mbo bana baoli ba Masiya;
english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

lokele: yamwesak’ino ko baɛlɛ kongo, itilesek’ino yinjo ya nyama eoka otitakɔkɔlɔkɔ ndola yao.
english: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

lokele: Eingo ko kwanikwani imɔ okakɔkɔli ndola yao, eoka okoyali nde balomboki, inga eba Bolimo. Kwa ayali ino la liya la liwesani sisi yanu, ¿loti to la litina mbo wende ko bato angɛnɛ ebati la Bolimo, ani otokelaka kwa atokela balomboki?
english: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

lokele: ¿Atoonga ɔmɔi mbo— Imi nd’ale to wa Paulo, la wasi mbo— Imi yende wa Apolo, eti to mbo wende ko balomboki kongo?
english: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

lokele: ¿Apolo ale to ndai? ¿Paulo ende ndai? Tole ngo ko basungi ba Ngɛnɛ ebatosung’ino nda liimeli kwa asofa Ngɛnɛ ofaefa oto la oto.
english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

lokele: Imi isolɔɔ koto; Apolo asowɛlɛ yao balia, kongo ko Mungu nd’atokondesa yao.
english: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

lokele: Ongoma la bɔlɔi la bɔwɛli wa balia bati yeka, kangä Oyatokondesa yao ako Mungu.
english: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

lokele: Nde bɔlɔi la bɔwɛli wa balia bende ko ɔmwito, batitwane, nde oto la oto atofomo ewande bondanda eoka ya eliande likuwa.
english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

lokele: Twende to bakuwani amamwito la Mungu; ino wende elanga ya Mungu, wende imɔ ndakɔ eyetoswomo la Mungu.
english: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

lokele: Kwa bonyafala wa elalaka oyasoakola ndoswa lionda lia ndakɔ, imi imɔ isoswa lionda lia ndakɔ ya Etanda ko la isosha esifomu’mi la Mungu, la wasi nd’atoswa likolo lia liao. Oto la oto asweke likolo lia liao la wɛlï la wɛlï to!
english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

lokele: Eoka lionda elisoswomo nda nyɛlɛ, oto wasi atikɔkɔlɛ ndoswa liasi, sakolo ko elisoswomo oso liko Yesu Masiya.
english: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

lokele: Nde boto eswa ndakɔ likolo lia lionda, ango bieto ya loketi, kwa pata kwa batalɛ ba bɔfɛkɔ, kwa baonga, kwa bangala, kwa kasa kongo, nde
english: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

lokele: likuwa lia oto la oto litɔɛnɛlɛ fololo; Lise lina lifi litotombola liao eoka litoisolomo ngo ko la bösä la bösä botokɔtɔlɔ bɔfɔnɔ wa likuwa lia oto la oto.
english: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

lokele: Eyambo likuwa elisoswa oto nda lionda likɔkɔmɔ, ani oto-yo kɔɔlɔ bondanda;
english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

lokele: nde eyambo likuwa lia oto lifechomo, likuwa angɛnɛ lisowa, kongo ko inde angɛnɛ atouwesomo, ambo kwa oto oyasɔɔnɔkɔlɔmɔ nda wambe wa bösä.
english: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

lokele: ¿Otiluweke mbo wende eyaelo ya Mungu la mbo Bolimo wa Mungu akoyali atiteni yanu?
english: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

lokele: Boto ebebesa eyaelo ya Mungu, Mungu kobebesa oto ona, eoka eyaelo ya Mungu esüchomo ko eoka yande la ino wende eyaelo ena.
english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

lokele: Boto atalimba botema wande angɛnɛ; ɔmɔi wanu eenyela mbo ende la wɛlï finɛ nda njasɔ ya wenda-bo, akinjweke ko ebebe mbo ayaleke la wɛlï wa Mungu.
english: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

lokele: Eoka wɛlï wa e-wenda-bo bole ko bibebe nda baiso ba Mungu, eoka kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ loao nda Lokasa, mbo— Atokusamela eba wɛlï nda shɔngɔlɔ shau angɛnɛ; la liasi mbo—
english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.” Job 5:13

lokele: Mungu nd’aluwi tofenya twa eba wɛlï, mbo tole ngo ko wawa kongo.
english: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.” Psalms 94:11

lokele: Ongoma to, oomalëke loasɔ loa bato, eoka bitotina yende eyanu,
english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

lokele: angoko Paulo, kwa Apolo, kwa Kefa, kwa wenda-bo, kwa liwawi, kwa liwa, kwa njasɔ ya mbile-ye, kwa ebikayeke mbisa, ambo bitotina fɛɛ yende yanu;
english: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

lokele: kongo ino wende eba Masiya, la Masiya ale wa Mungu.
english: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.

lokele: Tɛnɛngo, taenyelaka mbo iso twende ko basali ba Masiya la ebatoisokoela bato njasɔ ya Mungu ebiisomu ko mbiso;
english: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

lokele: nde oyatofomo likuwa-li, ambo aondu nde wolendelomu nda liao.
english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

lokele: Ende’mi lole ngo ko loasɔ lɔkɛkɛ ani likuwa liami lisotichakomo lanu ango ko la ikumbɛ sha bato basi, la imi angɛnɛ imɔ itikɔtɔlɛ likuwa liami.
english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

lokele: Itiluwe mbo eliami likuwa lile la litwanelo, kongo ko ititange mbo iti to la litwanelo; oyatokɔtɔlɔ’mi ale ko Ngɛnɛ Yesu.
english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

lokele: Eokao otafëke loasɔ se oso wa mbile ya loyo loa Ngɛnɛ oyatɔɛnɛsɛ fololo yao ebikoisama nda botufɛlɛ, atoisola kuko ya betema ya bato; kwaamao oto la oto atokaelomo loomalo eloande ko la Mungu angɛnɛ. Liɛngɔ eoka ya bɔmɛtɔ
english: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

lokele: Bitungani yami, nda njasɔ-bi isoonga kwa mbo bile ko loasɔ loasu la Apolo ko l’eoka yanu kongo, mbo boekeke ko lasu litina lia liölo-li, liko mbo— Angoakala lioi lia Lokasa; mbo ɔmɔi atayala la bɔmɛtɔ wolongela wasi.
english: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

lokele: ¿Ndai to nd’asolongesa ɔmɔi wanu likolo lia wina? ¿Loni elole laɛ elotifomo oso end’aɛ? ¿Wafomo to; monito otofaema la bɔmɛtɔ kwa mbo otifomo lifaefela?
english: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

lokele: Oisokanelo! Oisoyala oko bafoka! Oisoya bɛkɔta angotasungomo ko lasu batomomo! Aina to bolau mbo boyaleke bɛkɔta, ongoma la iso lanu toyalaneke imɔ l’isosha sha bɛkɔta!
english: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

lokele: Itangi nde mbo Mungu asotamb’iso Batomomo liili kwa bato ebasamboolomo ko bɔkɛcha nda baiso ba wenda bototina, la ende bakitomo la bato lisanga.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

lokele: Iso twende bibebe eoka ya Masiya; nde ino wende bato ba liluwani eoka ya Masiya. Iso twende bilɛli ya bato, nde ino wende to baesesi. Ino wende bato bolitesomo; nde iso twende bichambelo ya bato.
english: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

lokele: Konda eweuse tole la boeno wa yeka yola la yomwa, tosolengeela bisinda yowata; totoomakomoko mbaka, twende tɔkɛndi twa bato, angwɛnɛ bokenge.
english: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

lokele: Tosoya imɔ basali, totokela bakuwa la besamba yasu angɛnɛ; atomɔlɔmɔ iso, totosambola bato; atokongolomo iso, tosoikamaka se;
english: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

lokele: Atotɔngɔmɔ iso, tosɔɔnjɔnjɛl’iyo. Tosotangokomo ko wisi la lialala lia bokenge konda eweuse.
english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

lokele: Itisɔnɛl’ino ebaoi-ba ko ndokes’ino sɔni kangä ndofaef’ino bana basamomu bami ko liɛngɔ,
english: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

lokele: eoka ambo boyala la ambɔlɛ wa baekesi ba Masiya, kongo ko boti to la basango wike; imi nd’asokinjwa oyaot’ino ko la Mboli Ilau nda lina lia Yesu Masiya.
english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

lokele: Isotinjak’ino to mbo bokweekela’mi.
english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

lokele: Eokao isotomel’ino Timoteo oyale imɔ ko wana wami bosamomu wa lilendelu lia Ngɛnɛ, la oyatoenyeles’ino bɛkɛndɛli yami yotuta Yesu Masiya, chaa kwa atoekekesa’mi lolo lolo nda bitanda bitotina.
english: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

lokele: Bamɔi basoonga la bɔmɛtɔ mbo imi angoya end’ino,
english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

lokele: nde eyambo Ngɛnɛ esanga ongoma, yeyaka to lisasaya limɔ yeluwaka bofoka angɛnɛ wa bato ana ba bɔmɛtɔ, inga baoi ebatoong’iyo;
english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

lokele: eoka Bɔkɔta wa Mungu boti loasɔ loa boongaonga kangä loa bofoka wa Bolimo.
english: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

lokele: ¿Olɛmbi to iye? ¿Mbo iyeke end’ino la likuchi kwa mbo iyeke la losamɔ la botema sambo?
english: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

lokele: Mboli ya nyongo ya ɔmɔi wanu bisomelana finɛ, ende nyongo ibe eyetiluwane ango ende basenji, mbo ɔmɔi wanu asosɔngɔ wali wa sango wande,
english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

lokele: la osoënda la esaela! ¿Lotiete olau mbo oweke sɔni la mbo oyasokela loasɔ-lo asokolomoko sisi yanu?
english: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

lokele: Imi moni? Bindo yami yende esika lanu, nde bolimo wami bole tina lanu, la kwa asoyala to’mi tina lanu, isosila ndotena loasɔ loa boto oyasokela ongoma,
english: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

lokele: atosɔngɔmɔ’ino nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ Yesu la akayaleke ino amamwito la bolimo wami ko la bofoka wa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu,
english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

lokele: kokɛsɛ botoyo obe ende Satana mbo bindo yande esɛɛsɛlɛkɛ mbo bolimo wande angɛnɛ buwesomoko nda Lise lifi lia Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

lokele: Baoi banu ba esaela bati balau. ¿Otiluwe mbo sinyo sha bänä ba lilaka sitokɔkɔlɔ ndokakesa lituma litotina elisobiomu la shao?
english: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

lokele: Tasokolaka to lilaka elisokaka mbo oyaleke kwa lituma lina litanu liesi; Masiya asoolomo to loasɔ loasu kwa aolomoko nyama ya Elambɔ ya Lieti.
english: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

lokele: Ongoma, toleke to Elambɔ, inga la lituma elisoɔlɔ, elile la lilaka lia yɛmɛ ibe, kangä la lituma elitisobiomo la yeka, nde lile elia momongo angɛnɛ.
english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

lokele: Yasɔnɔkɔ nda lokasa loami mbo— Oyalanëke l’ebatotwa nyongo;
english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

lokele: nde inga to loasɔ loa eba wenda angɛnɛ ebati b’Etanda, kwa eba bolole, l’eba booni, kwa ebatosemola bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu, eoka ongoma engani nde ko ndosokwa nda wenda-bo.
english: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

lokele: Nde isɔni nde kwani mbo— Oyalëke la etungani w’Etanda oyale oto wa nyongo, wa bolole, wa lisemoli lia befɔnɔ ya mungu, oyatomɔlɔkɔ bato, oyatowaka bänä, la booni, oyalanëke la bɔfɔnɔ-bo wa boto, angola ango lande bieka!
english: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

lokele: ¿Ikomyeke bato ebati ba Etanda litina moni? ¿Loisoyala loanu ndokomya bato angɛnɛ b’Etanda?
english: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

lokele: Mungu nd’atokomya ebale lousa loa Etanda. Kusolaka boto ona obe lousa loa Etanda.
english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.” Deuteronomy 17:7

lokele: ¿Ndai wanu eyala la loasɔ ende wasi w’Etanda kotendela ndɔkɛ okakomya loao nda likita, inga nda ikumbɛ sh’Etanda?
english: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

lokele: ¿La otiluwe mbo eb’Etanda nd’atokomya njasɔ ya bato ba wenda? ¿Eya to mbo wenda bototi bokomyiomoko ko lanu, otiengane ndokomya tonja njasɔ angɛnɛ?
english: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

lokele: ¿Otiluwe mbo totokomyia njasɔ ya bakitomo, asa kɔni eya liwawi-li?
english: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

lokele: ¿Boyala to la njasɔ ya bɔfɔnɔ-bo, monito otokɛ la yao ende ebatilitesomo lanu nda Etanda?
english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

lokele: Isoonga ongoma mbo okeke sɔni. ¿Mbo boti la boto angɔmɔi wa wɛlï oyatokɔkɔlɔ ndokomyel’ino bitungani ya Etanda njasɔ;
english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

lokele: kangä mbo oto w’Etanda kɔkɛsɛ loasɔ loa wina nda likomyi ko oso wa bato ebatiimele?
english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

lokele: Ongoma wende to la litwanelo eoka mbo otokɛsɛnɛ nda likita la njasɔ yanu. ¿Loisoeta olau ndokelomo obe, lotiengane ndolimbomo la ndomɛsɛlɛ loao?
english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

lokele: Kongo ko ino angɛnɛ nd’atokela obe la otolimbaka ango baina ba Etanda angɛnɛ. Beimo eoka ya njasɔ ya bɔwɛwɛ
english: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

lokele: ¿Otiluwe mbo ebati la liengani batisangole elela nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu? Olimbomöko nda betema yanu; eba belëfë, ebatosemola bɛfɔnɔ, eba nyongo, l’ebatotombolana bindo la tosumbe,
english: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

lokele: l’eba biya, eba bolole, ebatowaka bänä, ebatomɔlɔkɔ bato, eba booni, ambo batotina-ba batisangole Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

lokele: Wayalaka nde bamɔi banu, ko l’ebɔfɔnɔ-bo, kongo ko ososoolomo batwanelo, osüchomo nda Etanda, osoenganesomo eoka ya lina lia Ngɛnɛ Yesu Masiya la eoka ya Bolimo wa Mungu wasu.
english: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

lokele: Boto eonga mbo— Bitotina biengani nde lami ndokela; nde bitotina bitisangele la bolau. Beonga mbo— Bitotina biengani lami ndokela; kongo ko imi itiyokakalesomoko la yɛmɛ ango ɛmɔi.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

lokele: Bieka yola biyali loasɔ loa sɔlɔ la sɔlɔ ko loasɔ loa bieka, la Mungu atosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ yao imbale. Bindo etikelomo ko eoka ya bolëfë, kangä eoka ya Ngɛnɛ la Ngɛnɛ wasu imɔ ko l’eoka ya bindo.
english: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

lokele: Mungu nd’atɛmwɛsɛkɛ Ngɛnɛ wasu nda liwa, limɔ ɛtɛmwɛsɛkɛ imɔ ko iso ko la bofoka wande.
english: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

lokele: ¿Otiluwe mbo bindo yanu bende bilengo ya Masiya? ¿Yɔsɛkɛ to bilengo ya Masiya ndowachaka yao l’ewa bolëfë? Mbayo, ango sinyo!
english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

lokele: ¿Oisoluwa mbo boto oyatowatema la botomali wa bolëfë, ambo iyo yaambale bende ko bindo emwito? Eoka Lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Iyo yaambale beyalaka nde ko bindo emwito.
english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.” Genesis 2:24

lokele: Nde oyatowatema la Ngɛnɛ ale lande ko bolimo ɔmwito.
english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

lokele: Kwelaka bolëfë botili fwaa! Njasɔ ibe yasi bitotina ebitokela boto bitikelakomo nda bindo angɛnɛ, nde botwaki wa bolëfë bosobebesa bindo yande angɛnɛ.
english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

lokele: Otiluwe imɔ mbo bindo yaɛ ende eyaelo ya Bolimo Botanu oyale atiteni laɛ Oyasokwaka ende Mungu?
english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

lokele: Otiomane lanu angɛnɛ, wasombomoko la bolïli. Eokao omalesaka Mungu ko la bindo yanu.
english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

lokele: Nda loasɔ lona to eloasɔnɔk’ino, bolau woeta bole ko mbo boto angowatema la botomali nda lisɔngɔni.
english: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

lokele: Kongo ko kwa asoya belëfë likama, botolome la otolome asɛlɛkɛ ewande wali, la wali la wali asɛlɛkɛ ewande olome.
english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

lokele: Bolome la bolome afaefeke wali wande yao ebiengani la lisɔngɔni, ko ongoma wali ende olome wande;
english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, 7:3 and likewise also the wife her husband.

lokele: wali ati ngɛnɛ wa bindo yande angɛnɛ, kangä olome. Ko ongoma bolome imɔ ati ngɛnɛ wa bindo yande, kangä wali.
english: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

lokele: Ofekelanëke lisɔngɔni, ambo ani osokuliana ongoma ko la mbile sinyo, mbo wɛnɛkɛ fofe ya lisomboli, limɔ mbisa koyalana liasi mbo Satana atasoshel’ino ko la boeno wanu wɔɔngɛsɛ yɛmɛ yanu.
english: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

lokele: Isoonga ongoma ko ndolɛmbɛl’ino sumbu, inga mbo Mungu nd’ateli nde’mi ekela nda loasɔ-lo.
english: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

lokele: Kongo imi nd’alɛmbi mbo batotina bayaleke kwa ayali nde imi ko bɔkɔlɔ; nde oto la oto afomu nde boyaeli ewande bolau ko la Mungu.
english: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

lokele: Ende bɛkɔlɔ la ende ebawelu balome isoonga mbo losoeta la olau ani batikaleke kwa ayali nde’mi angosɔngɔ imɔ;
english: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

lokele: nde eyambo batikɔkɔlɛ ndofeka yɛmɛ, batasɔngɔkɔ to, eoka ndosɔngɔ esoeta ndofɛfɛ la bolëfë.
english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

lokele: Ende ebasosɔngɔ isotela ekela, inga to’mi kangä Ngɛnɛ nd’ataka yao, mbo wali angosɛnyana la olome wande—
english: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

lokele: nde eya mbo basosila oko ndosɛnyana ani botomali angosɔngɔnɔ imɔ, angoko koinywa liasi ende bolome— la otolome angosokola wali wande.
english: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

lokele: Ende ebamɔi, imi angɛnɛ nd’asoonga, inga to Ngɛnɛ, mbo ango oto wa Etanda eyala la wali oyatiimele, nde wali ekulia ndoyala lande, ongoma bolome angosokol’inde.
english: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

lokele: Ko ongoma imɔ, otomali w’Etanda eyala la olome oyatiimele, nde bolome ekulia ndoyala lande, ongoma wali angosɛnyana lande.
english: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

lokele: Eoka botolome oyatiimele asüchomo ko l’eoka ya wali wande, la wali imɔ oyatiimele asüchomo ko l’eoka ya olome wande oyasoimela; aenaka ongoma ani bana banu kokwa bokili wa nyongo, kongo ko basüchomo nda Etanda.
english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

lokele: Nde oyatiimele ɛlɛmbɛ ndosɛnyana, ambo basɛnyanɛkɛ; nda bɔfɔnɔ-bo wa loasɔ, oto wa Etanda, otomali kwa otolome, atikandomo; Mungu asot’iso lioi mbo toyaleke la lilatemi.
english: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

lokele: ¿Wali wa oto, oluwi nde kwa mbo otouwesa bolome waɛ; l’aɛ imɔ bolome, oluwi nde kwa mbo otouwesa wali waɛ?
english: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

lokele: Kongo ko bolau ngo mbo boto la boto ayaleke la boyaeli ewafomoko inde la ani atomoko inde lioi ko la Ngɛnɛ Mungu. Isotela bitanda bitotina ekela-ye ongoma.
english: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

lokele: ¿Watinyaka to itombe ani Mungu atak’aɛ lioi? Angosokola imɔ loelo loa itombe. ¿Ndai ayalaka ko losunga ani Mungu atak’inde lioi? Atinyomöko itombe!
english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

lokele: Itombe sitiyale loasɔ; losunga imɔ lotiyale loasɔ. Kongo ko lilitesi lia Bikela ya Mungu lile nde loasɔ loeta.
english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

lokele: Kwani ayalaka boto la boto nda mbile eyatomoko inde lioi, bolau mbo atikaleke ngo ko ongoma.
english: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

lokele: ¿Wayalaka bɔkɔwa ani watomoko lioi? Otakelëke loao bolenda, kongo ko bokɔkɔlɔ ndoendolomo, wɛnɛkɛ fofe, ambo bolau.
english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

lokele: Bɔkɔwa oyasotomo lioi la Ngɛnɛ Yesu, ambo ale ko iote sha Ngɛnɛ; ongoma imɔ iote oyasotomo lioi ale ko bɔkɔwa wa Yesu.
english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

lokele: Wasombomokö la bolïli; oyalëk’imɔ bɛkɔwa ya bato kongo.
english: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

lokele: Bitungani yami, kwani ayalaka boto la boto eyatomoko inde lioi, atikaleke ngo ko ani amamwito la Mungu wosungak’inde. Likomyi lia baseka la bakɔlɔ nda lisɔngɔni
english: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

lokele: Nda loasɔ loa baseka, itiɔlɛ ekela ya Ngɛnɛ, nde itof’ino liölo lia loasɔ-lo kwa boto wolendelomo ko l’eoka ya booto wa Ngɛnɛ ende’mi.
english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

lokele: Im’isoenyela to mbo, eoka ya bifembi ebikayeke nda mbile-ye, bolau mbo boto atikaleke ko la boyaeli ebole lande kwani.
english: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

lokele: ¿Wende la wali? Olukëke fofe yosɛnyana lande. ¿Otiyale imɔ la wali? Olukëk’imɔ wali wasi.
english: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

lokele: Nde eyambo bɔsɔngɔ imɔ, liti to litwanelo la boseka esɔngɔnɔ, liti to litwanelo. Kongo ko ebatosɔngɔnɔ bɛnɛkɛ nde bifembi ya liwawi-li la imi nd’alɛmbi ndokufesel’ino yao.
english: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

lokele: Litina elitoonga’mi lanu, bitungani yami, lile mbo mbile ebisotikala bit’imɔ yumwa. Ko la yao ebitikali nde, mbo ebasosɔngɔ bayaleke kwa mbo bati la wali,
english: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

lokele: ebasolela batayalaka kwa mbo batilele oto, ebasoyaimwaka batayalaka kwa mbo batioke limɛngɔ; ebatɔkɛkɛ bokalala, batayalaka kwa mbo batisɛlɛ bieto,
english: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

lokele: la ebasofomo isosha nda wenda-bo kwa mbo batikakalese wao, eoka likɔmɔnyi lia wenda-bo likosekwasekwa fwaa.
english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

lokele: Itilɛmbɛ mbo ino oyaleke la tolöi twa wenda; oyati la wali atokɛsɛlɛ njasɔ ya Ngɛnɛ iyɛli mbo aomaleseke Ngɛnɛ,
english: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

lokele: nde oyale la wali atɔkɛsɛlɛ njasɔ ya wenda iyɛli mbo aomaleseke wali wande,
english: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

lokele: ongoma asoeyaeya. Ongoma to la bosanga la boseka batokɛsɛlɛ njasɔ ya Ngɛnɛ iyɛli shoüchel’Inde la bindo la botema lisanga. Nde botomali oyale la olome akokɛsɛlɛ eya wenda iyɛli mbo aomaleseke olome wande.
english: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

lokele: Isoongel’ino baölo-ba ko ndofotes’ino, inga ndokufesel’ino, kangä mbo oliteseke likomɔnyi lilau la mbo okuweleke Ngɛnɛ angoeyaeya nda botema.
english: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

lokele: Nde eyambo boto etanga nde mbo atikomye boseka wande loasɔ loa liäla la wɛlï ani engani nde ndosɔngɔnɔ eoka mbo boseka asɔfɛtɛ bindo, ambo loti la loasɔ, iyo la liäla basɔngɔnɛkɛ.
english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

lokele: Kongo ko ango boto ekɔkɔmɔ nda botema wande, la ani loasɔ loasi lotitakomyomo, la ani boto ale l’isosha shokela ani, esanga nda botema ndotikala la wana wande ko boseka kongo, lole imɔ ko lolau elosokel’inde.
english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

lokele: Ongoma to, boto oyasosɔngɛsɛ boseka wande asokela olau, la oyatisɔngɛsɛ wana wande asokela bolau woeta.
english: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

lokele: Wali asokandomo la olome wande la mbile bitotina ebiyal’inde la liwawi, nde bolome ewa, wali atikandomo imɔ, asɔngɔnɛkɛ oyatosang’inde, ko botolome wa Etanda kongo.
english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

lokele: Nde nda botema wami isoenyela mbo etikala ani angosɔngɔmɔ imɔ, eyalaka nde la limɛngɔ; la itangi nde mbo yende imɔ la Bolimo wa Mungu nda botema wami.
english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

lokele: Kwani to loasɔ loa bieka ebisotambomo oso wa bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu; toluwi nde mbo iso yaatotina tole la wɛlï nda loasɔ-lo. Kongo ko wɛlï angɛnɛ bototumesa bato la bɔmɛtɔ, nde losamɔ lotokɔkɔmɛsɛ bato la olau.
english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

lokele: Boto etanga nde mbo asɔɔlɔ wɛli, ambo akaluwi wao ewengani lande ndoluwa.
english: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

lokele: Nde boto esama nde Mungu, boto ona asoluwomo la Mungu.
english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

lokele: Nda loasɔ loa bieka ebisotambomo nda lisemoli lia bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu, toluwi to mbo angwɛnɛ mungu ya bɛfɔnɔ ya wewe nda wenda-bo, la angwɛnɛ Mungu sakolo ngo ko Ɔmwito.
english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

lokele: Nde yao ebisofomo lina mbo mungu, kwa nda use angoko ono se nda nyɛlɛ-bende bamungu la bangɛnɛ wike,—
english: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

lokele: kongo ko iso nd’ayali la Mungu ko Ɔmwito ako Sango oyakelaka bitotina la iso yaatotina tosoomana lande, la Ngɛnɛ ko Ɔmwito ako Yesu Masiya oyakɔkɔmɛsɛkɛ bitotina la iso bato lisanga.
english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

lokele: Nde wɛlï-bo botiyale la batotina, nde bamɔi basotanga mbo bɛfɔnɔ yende wewe konda wainɛngɛ ko kwani la batolaka bieka ina mbo bisotambomo ende mungu ya bɛfɔnɔ limɔ eoka mbo elembeelo ya botema ele la bɔlɛmbu, iyo ana basobeba eoka ya bokili ebosowang’iyo.
english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

lokele: Nde bieka biitoiyes’iso ende Mungu; tokila bieka toitoomelo la tola iso angofota.
english: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

lokele: Kongo ko tichaka la wɛlï mbo lisokoli lia bokili wanu litakwesa basi ebatikɔkɔmɛ.
english: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

lokele: ¿Ango boto to ɛɛnɛ aɛ, boto wa wɛlï nda loasɔ-lo, ani otolaka bieka nda mɛsa ya esemoelo ya bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu ani inde angola ko l’eoka mbo elembeelo yande etikɔkɔmɛ loasɔ loa bieka nda esemoelo ya bɛfɔnɔ?
english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

lokele: Ongoma etungani yaɛ oyatikɔkɔmɛ asosɛɛsɛlɛ eoka ya wɛlï waɛ ani Masiya awelaka nde etungani ena.
english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

lokele: Ko ongoma asokeël’ino bitungani yanu obe ko ndoswak’iyo baswa nda elembeelo eyetikɔkɔmɛ, osokeel’imɔ ko Masiya obe.
english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

lokele: Eokao eyambo yekwesa etungani yami se ko l’eoka ya bieka ina ebisola’mi, itialek’imɔ yao liasi ko layalaya, mbo itakwesa etungani yami se.
english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

lokele: ¿Boyaeli wami angɛnɛ moni? ¿Iisofaikolomo bokili wa bikela ya Mɔsɛ? ¿Iti to Botomomu? ¿Itiɛnɛkɛ Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu? ¿Oisowatekema la Ngɛnɛ Yesu ko l’eoka ya likuwa liami?
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

lokele: Ambo bamɔi basi beenyela mbo imi iti Botomomu nde yende ewanu Botomomu; ino wende ndembe ya chapa ya lotomomo loami la Ngɛnɛ end’ino.
english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

lokele: Isomutoela to ebatokɔtɔlɔ’mi ko la baoi-ba.
english: My defense to those who examine me is this:

lokele: ¿Mbo iso Batomomu toti l’isosha shɔɔlɔ yeka yola la yomwa?
english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

lokele: ¿Mbo toti l’isosha shokɛsɛnɛ la wali oyale l’Etanda, kwa atokelaka batomomu ebamɔi la bitungani ya Ngɛnɛ la Kefa imɔ?
english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

lokele: ¿Mbo iso lami la Balanaba kongo toti l’isosha shomacha likuwa lia besamba yasu angɛnɛ?
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

lokele: ¿Boni to bosilikani atolaka bieka ebisomb’inde angɛnɛ? ¿Oyatokuwa elanga aitolaka yeka ya eula? ¿Botingani wa liasa lia mbuli angotamwa baɛlɛ ba liasa?
english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

lokele: ¿Mbo isoonga ongoma ko l’isosha sha bato kongo? ¿Kwa mbo bikela ya Mɔsɛ biisoonga ko ongoma?
english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

lokele: Nda Lokasa loa bikela ya Mɔsɛ loasɔnɔmɔkɔ mbo— Okandëke bolomba wa mbolo oyatomatekela befonga nda etwangelo.
english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Deuteronomy 25:4 Is it for the oxen that God cares,

lokele: ¿Mbo Mungu asokɛsɛ ko mbolo iyɛli kongo? ¿Mbo aisoonga ongoma ko l’eoka yasu? Lioi-li losɔnɔmɔ nde eoka yasu mbo bokuwaki w’elanga la oyatotwaka eula bakeleke likuwa ko l’iyɛli sholaka bieka ya eula.
english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

lokele: ¿Iso tolɔɔ koto ya Bolimo nda eyanu betema, lole to loasɔ lofi mbo iso kɔɔlɔ likaɔ lia eyanu bieka ya bindo?
english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

lokele: ¿Ango basi befomo to likaɔ ko l’isosha shanu, simbi to iso kofomo i? Kongo ko totifote ko l’eoka ya Isosha shɔ̈ɔlɔ likaɔ nde tosotendela boeno mbo totakufesa likɛndɛsi lia Mboli Ilau ya Masiya.
english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

lokele: ¿Botiluweke mbo ba kanga ebatokuwela esemoelo ya Mungu nd’atɔɔlɔ likaɔ lia bieka omao la mbo ebatotambaka bafaefi nda etambelo nd’atɔɔlɔ likaɔ lia bafaefi?
english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

lokele: Ko ongoma imɔ Ngɛnɛ wasu ataka ekela mbo ebatonangokola Mboli Ilau bɛnɛkɛ yeka yoengana beeno yau ko nda yao.
english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

lokele: Kongo ko im’itiɔ̈lɛ ango shaya eoka ya isosha-si la itisɔnɛ baoi-ba mbo yɔlɛkɛ bieka ongoma; losoeta la olau mbo itawaka, inga to mbo boto kotombola liomali liami lionangola wawa;
english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

lokele: eoka ango yenangolaka Mboli Ilau, iti to la litina lioyala la bɔmɛtɔ eoka lwende ngo lotimbana loami kongo la liömä liwɛlɛmɛkɛ ende’mi ani itinangole Mboli Ilau.
english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

lokele: Yenangola to la lisangi liami, ani imi kɔɔlɔ bondanda olau, nde la wuno likuwa lile kwa elia bɔkɔwa.
english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

lokele: ¿Boni to bondanda ebokɔɔlɛkɛ’mi? Ebo kongo, mbo itonangola Mboli Ilau lifaefela angofota l’isosha nda linangoli lia yao.
english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

lokele: Eoka kwa asoyala’mi iyote sha boto, isoyala bɔkɔwa wa batotina ko la lisangi liami angɛnɛ mbo yɔlɛkɛ ambɔlɛ wa bato botuta Ngɛnɛ.
english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

lokele: Yakɛkɛ ende BaYuda kwa WaYuda mbo yɔlɛkɛ BaYuda, yakɛkɛ ende ebatolitesa Bikela ya Mɔsɛ kwa ɔmɔi wau angɛnɛ-ani iti wau wewembo yɔlɛkɛ balitesi ba Bikela;
english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, 9:20 that I might gain those who are under the law;

lokele: yakɛkɛ ende ebatilitese Bikela kwa ɔmɔi oyatilitese Bikela inga mbo itilitese Mungu, eoka itolitesa Bikela ya Masiya angɛnɛ— mbo yɔlɛkɛ ebatilitese Bikela.
english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

lokele: Ende eba ɛlɛli, yayalaka l’ɛlɛli mbo yɔlɛkɛ eba ɛlɛli. Isotayala kwa bɛfɔnɔ ya batotina mbo yuweseke bamɔi bau batotina.
english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

lokele: Itokelaka ongoma ko l’eoka ya Mboli Ilau mbo yɔlɛkɛ likaɔ lia Mboli Ilau la liuwesi lia yao amamwito lau.
english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

lokele: ¿Botiluweke mbo nda fɔmbi yokɛsɛnɛ mangu batotina nd’atokwaka mangu, ko ɔmɔi kongo nd’atɔɔlɔ bondanda wa bolongi; kwaka to ongoma mbo ɔsɛkɛ wao!
english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

lokele: Oso wa lise lia fɔmbi batotina ebatofumba ndolonga batokakalesa yɛmɛ ya bindo; iyo batofumba mbo baɔlɛkɛ bondanda ebotobɛɛkɛlɛ nde iso ko wao ebotilasɛɛsɛlɛ imɔ.
english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

lokele: Imi nd’atokwaka mangu ko ongoma, fii nda mboka; asonana’mi liangɔ, iitofaliana ko besamba wawa,
english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

lokele: nde itonana la bindo yami angɛnɛ ndokakalesa yao kwa bɔkɔwa wami, litina mbo imi ako ikomya sha linangoli, itafekomoko.
english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

lokele: Bitungani yami, itilɛmb’ino ndoosala mbo basango basu baaka kwala iyo batotina ebalinjomoko la lifita nda liɔmbɛlɛ la iyo batotina loeta Balia batelu,
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

lokele: la batotina fɛɛ lolufiomo la nda balia la nda lifita ko la isosha sha Mɔsɛ.
english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

lokele: Iyo yaatotina lolaka bieka ya bolimo la
english: and all ate the same spiritual food;

lokele: iyo lomwaka limwi eliafomoko iyo yaatotina la Bolimo, eingo eoka batoti bamwaka balia ba litalɛ lia Bolimo eliatutak’iyo, Litalɛ lina liaaka ko Masiya angɛnɛ.
english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

lokele: Kongo ko Mungu atiaomalaka loasɔ loa wike wa bato ana la iyo lokwakwa se belyo wike nda liɔmbɛlɛ.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

lokele: Njasɔ-bi yende to beimo end’iso, ndoim’iso mbo totafɛ̈fɛ̈ la yɛmɛ ya bobe kwa akelaka iyo.
english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

lokele: Eingo, oyalëke basemoli ba bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu kwa ayalaka bamɔi bau; ongoma lososɔnɔmɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Bato loyalaka se ko ndola la ndomwa, limɔ aemalak’iyo ko ndoinaka bisha.
english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.” Exodus 32:6

lokele: Tokelëke bolëfë kwa akelaka bamɔi bau limɔ iyo lowaka ko bilɛfu kama imbale la bilɛfu isatɔ ko la lise-ao.
english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

lokele: Tokotëke ndososhela Ngɛnɛ Mungu kwa akelaka bamɔi bau limɔ basɛɛsɛlɛsɔmɔkɔ la njɔ;
english: Let’s not test Christ, 10:9 as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

lokele: totaimaima ndofekela Mungu kwa akelaka bamɔi bau limɔ basɛɛsɛlɛsɔmɔkɔ ko la Boombesi.
english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

lokele: Beimo bitotina-bi yawɛlɛmɛkɛ end’iyo nde yasɔnɔmɔkɔ nda lokasa ndoekekes’iso ebasooshomo kwani ko la tuu ya mbile-ye.
english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

lokele: Eokao oyasoenyela mbo asokɔkɔmɔ kɔkɛ, atawɛlɛkɛ baiso mbo atakwa se.
english: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

lokele: Lisoshela liitoyak’end’ino sakolo ko liao elitoundana la balomboki. Mungu ale wolendelomo to, la aitomachel’aɛ ndososhelomo la lisoshelomu liolonga bofoka waɛ nde amamwito la liao atoeshel’aɛ imɔ ko esokwelo mbo okɔkɔlɛkɛ ndotendela liao.
english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

lokele: Eokao, basamomu lami, kwelaka lisemoli lia bɛfɔnɔ botili.
english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

lokele: Isoonga lanu kwa ende bato ebatolaila la wɛlï; ino angɛnɛ kweelaka litina lia baoi ebatoonga’mi.
english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

lokele: ¿Kɔpɔ eyetosomboel’iso lifoti nda Elambɔ eti to mbo tosokaana liuwesi lia bakila ba Masiya? ¿Lituma elitounak’iso liti to likao lia biale ya bindo ya Masiya?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

lokele: Kwa ayali lituma ko limɔi, ko ongoma iso ebale ko wike, twende kwa bindo imwito, eoka iso yatotina totokaa ko lituma limɔi.
english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

lokele: Tichaka to BaIsalaele la beyaeli yau; ¿Ebatolaka nyama ebisotambomo lifaefi, baisokaana imɔ ko eya etambelo?
english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

lokele: ¿Iongi to nd’iye? ¿Mbo lifaefi elitambomu bɛfɔnɔ liende yeka? ¿Kwa mbo bɔfɔnɔ wa mungu wende to la litina?
english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

lokele: Mbayɔ. Nde isoonga mbo lifaefi elisotamba balomboki nda lisemoli lititambomo Mungu, kangä balimo. Itilɛmbɛ to ino ndoyala basaɔ ba balimo.
english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

lokele: Otikɔkɔlɛ ndomwa kɔpɔ ya Ngɛnɛ la kɔpɔ ya balimo lisanga; otikɔkɔlɛ ndoyala se nda bieka ya Elambɔ ya Ngɛnɛ la nda eya balimo lisanga.
english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

lokele: ¿Kwa mbo tosofɔɔlɔ bokelë wa Ngɛnɛ? ¿Mbo tosolongel’Inde la bofoka?
english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

lokele: Mbo bitotina biengani nde lami ndokela? Kongo ko bitotina biitosung’iso. Mbo bitotina biengani nde lami ndokela, kongo ko bitotina biitokɔkɔmɛsɛ Etanda;
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

lokele: boto alukëke ko bolau wande angɛnɛ, kangä ewa bato basi.
english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

lokele: Laka to bieka ya kanda bitotina ya liongo, angotafelaka litina loasɔ loa botema waɛ,
english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

lokele: eoka mbo— Bitotina ebile nda wenda-bo bile ngo ko eya Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.” Psalms 24:1

lokele: Eyambo ɔmɔi w’ebatiimele et’ino lioi nda bieka, bɔlɛmbɛ, aɛ kɔkɛ okala bitotina ebisofomo aɛ, angotafelaka litina nda botema waɛ.
english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

lokele: Kongo ko eya to mbo boto eonga laɛ mbo— Bieka-bi biüchomu nde loasɔ loa bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu, olëk’imɔ eoka yande oyasoluwes’aɛ la eoka ya botema.
english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

lokele: Itionge loasɔ loa botema waɛ angɛnɛ kangä eoka ya elembeelo ya botema wa wina laɛ. ¿Mbo losokolomo loa bokili wami lotolendelo likomyi lia botema wa boto wasi?
english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

lokele: ¿Ango imi yela bieka ko la bootaota wa Mungu, monito batosɛɔlɔ’mi ko l’eoka ya bieka ina ebisoongomo kelekëlë?
english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

lokele: Eokao, bola yeka, bomwaka, bokela loasɔ angolɔmɔi, kelaka bitotina ngo ko ndoomalesa Mungu.
english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

lokele: Oyalëke to ebatokwesaka basi tolango, kwa BaYuda, kwa BaHela, kwa eba Etanda ya Mungu;
english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

lokele: la imi ko ongoma itokota ndosunga bato basi batotina ko la njasɔ bitotina, itiluke bondanda wami angɛnɛ kangä ewa basi wike mbo buwesomoko! Yalaka to batutaki ba boyaeli wami kwa atotutaka’mi ewa Masiya.
english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

lokele: Isoinel’ino to eoka otoenyakela’mi la baoi batotina bami la ndola bitotina ebisoaekelana’mi ndotel’ino ko yao;
english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

lokele: kongo ko ilɛmbi nde mbo oluweke la wɛlï mbo Masiya ale Botö wa bato batotina, botolome ale botö wa wali wande, Mungu ale Botö wa Masiya.
english: But I would have you know that the head 11:3 of every man is Christ, and the head 11:3 of the woman is man, and the head 11:3 of Christ is God.

lokele: Botolome ewata yeka yolinjaka botö wande ani atosombola, ango ani atonangola, ambo asotefwesa botö wande la sɔni;
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

lokele: nde botomali oyatosombola, ango atonangola ani atilinjeke botö wande, ambo asotefwesa botö wande la sɔni-lole kwa mbo asomwomo swee ya botö loasɔ loa sɔni.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

lokele: Ango botomali atilinjeke botö wande, ani bolau ko mbo amweke swee yande, kongo ko eya to mbo lole sɔni ende otomali ndomwomo swee ango ndoyala litunu, atawataka to esinda yolinjaka botö.
english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

lokele: Nde botolome ati l’isosha sholinjaka botö eoka ale la bɔfɔnɔ la bɔfɛkɔ wa Mungu nde botomali ale bɔfɛkɔ wa botolome.
english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

lokele: Nde otolome atiakelomokö ko ndokuswa ende otomali, kangä otomali nd’akuswaka ende otolome.
english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

lokele: La imɔ mbo otolome atiakelomoko litina lia otomali, kangä otomali litina lia otolome.
english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

lokele: Ko l’eoka-ao lole ende otomali ndolinjaka botö wande kwa ndembe y’isosha la eoka ya bakitomo.
english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

lokele: Nde luwaka imɔ mbo nda lisangi lia Ngɛnɛ wasu botomali atiyale ko inde angɛnɛ kongo, la otolome angoyala ko inde kongo;
english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

lokele: eoka kwa asokwaka otomali wa osooso atiteni ya otolome, ongoma to kwani botolome asootomo ko la otomali, la yaatotina bitosokwaka ko ende Mungu angɛnɛ.
english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

lokele: Ino angɛnɛ kɔtɔlɔkɔ loasɔ-lo nda betema yanu. ¿Mbo ende to olau mbo otomali asomboleke Mungu ani atilinje botö wande?
english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

lokele: ¿Mbo botolome wa wanganga oyatitene swee aitoka sɔni? ¿Nde botomali eyala la swee bisa biisoyala ko bɔfɛkɔ wande?
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

lokele: Swee bifomu nd’otomali kwa yeka yolinjak’inde—
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

lokele: Nde e-loasɔ-lo loti loasɔ loa bosho, oyatolɛmbɛ ndowalana nda loao, aluweke mbo iso totikulie beyaeli wasi la Bitanda ya Mungu ko ongoma imɔ. Ikumbɛ sha Etanda
english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

lokele: Nde nda loasɔ loa lisɔngɔmi lia Etanda, atofa’mi of’ino likakanelo, itiinel’ino eoka otisɔngɔmɛ la wɛlï kangä la libebesi.
english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

lokele: Loasɔ loa oso, isooka mbo atosɔngɔmɔ ino nda Etanda, otoatakana botuka la botuka, la im’isoenyela sumbu mbo ende ongoma.
english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

lokele: Eoka loengani nde mbo wataneke botuka la botuka mbo ebasolembeelomo mbo bengani, baluwomoko wewe. Elambɔ ya Ngɛnɛ Yesu
english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

lokele: Atosɔngɔkɔmɔ ino nda elela ɛmɔi eti to ko ndola Elambɔ ya Ngɛnɛ;
english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

lokele: eoka boto la boto atotaɔsɔ eyande yeka kwa elambɔ yande, limɔ ɔmɔi atoka isiyɛ la wasi asokanelo la limwi.
english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

lokele: ¿Monito, mbo oti la ndakɔ olo atola ino bieka la atomwak’ino? ¿Mbo ototefwesa Etanda ya Mungu la otochambola bato ebati la yeka? ¿Iongeke to moni; mbo iinelek’ino? Nda loasɔ-lo iitoinel’ino!
english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

lokele: Imi nd’afak’ino kwa afaka Ngɛnɛ ofa’mi, loko mbo Ngɛnɛ Yesu nda ocho ona ewawambomoko Inde nda liwa, Inde lounda lituma;
english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

lokele: Inde lofaefa Mungu kelekëlë, limɔ Inde louna liao, Inde loonga mbo— Eli lile bindo yami ebile eoka yanu; kelakaka ani ko ndoenyakela’mi.
english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

lokele: Ko ongoma mbisa yola, Inde lofaef’iyo kɔpɔ, Inde mbo— E-kɔpɔ-ye yende Ngɛla Eyai eyetinyomu nda bakila bami; atomwak’ino kɔpɔ-ye, kelakaka ani ko ndoenyakela Imi.
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

lokele: Eoka mbile bitotina ebitolak’ino lituma-li la ebitomwak’ino e-kɔpɔ-ye ele ko yota boeki wa litina lia liwa lia Ngɛnɛ wasu konda loyo loasi loande.
english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

lokele: Eokao oyatola lituma-li, ango oyatomwa kɔpɔ-ye la bɔfɔnɔ ebotiengane ambo asoyala la nyongo nda bindo ya Ngɛnɛ la bakila bande.
english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

lokele: Boto atatichaka botema wande angɛnɛ, limɔ aleke lituma la amweke kɔpɔ la bɔfɔnɔ eboöndu olau.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

lokele: Eoka oyatola la oyatomwa angoenyela bindo la wɛlï, asola la asomwa lokomyo loande angɛnɛ.
english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

lokele: Ko la litina-li wike banu basolɛlɛ la kambo la bamɔi basoingala tɔlɔ twa liwa.
english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

lokele: Nde eya to mbo tokomya betema yasu angɛnɛ wewe, ani iso angofomo se.
english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

lokele: Kongo ko asokomyomo iso, tosokuchomo la Ngɛnɛ kwa asokuchomo bainɛngɛ mbo totafomo se amamwito la wenda-bo.
english: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

lokele: Ongoma to, bitungani yami, akasɔngɔmɛk’ino ndola Elambɔ, umbakelanaka—
english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

lokele: ango ɔmɔi ewa l’isiyɛ atalaka bieka olo eyande-litina mbo otasɔngɔmɔ ko ndofomo se. Itoaesa njasɔ ebimɔi se, eyekayeke’mi end’ino.
english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

lokele: Bitungani yami, itilɛmbɛ mbo oyaleke la botutuku nda loasɔ loa bafi ebasofomo la Bolimo.
english: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

lokele: Oluwi nde mbo ani ayalak’ino ko basenji walimbomoko, kwa alimbakomoko ino mbile la mbile, ko ndosemola bɛfɔɔnɔ ya mungu ya biuma.
english: You know that when you were heathen, 12:2 you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

lokele: Eokao kwani isoluwes’ino la wɛlï mbo boto oyasɔɔtɛlɔmɔ la Bolimo wa Mungu angokɔkɔlɔ ndoonga mbo— Yesu asendomoko bieo! Boto angokɔkɔlɔ ndoonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ wasu ko Yesu! sakolo ngo ko l’isosha sha Bolimo Botanu.
english: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

lokele: Bafaefi ebafomu la Bolimo bende la bɔfɔnɔ la bɔfɔnɔ, nde Bolimo angɛnɛ ale ko ɔmwito,
english: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

lokele: la bɛfɔnɔ ya bekuweli yokuwela Ngɛnɛ bile to wike, nde Ngɛnɛ ale ko ɔmɔi kongo.
english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

lokele: Bofoka wa Mungu bɔle la bɛfɔnɔ wike, nde ale ko Mungu ɔmwito oyatokɔkɔlɛsɛ yao bitotina ende batotina ebasɛlɛ yao.
english: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

lokele: Bolimo bosɔɛnɛlɛ ende boto la boto wa Masiya litina mbo batotina bafotesomoko lande.
english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

lokele: Ende boto ɔmɔi Bolimo asofa lioi lia wɛlï; ende wasi ko lioi lia liluwani ko la Bolimo-ao;
english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

lokele: ende wasi ko liimeli lifi imɔ ko la Bolimo; ende wasi asofa bofoka wouwesaka ngwo imɔ ko la Bolimo-bo;
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

lokele: ende wasi asofa bofoka wokelaka bisisho yolongela eya bato; ende wasi ko isosha shonangola; ende wasi isosha sholuwa balimo ebalau l’ebati balau; ende wasi isosha shoonga la baoi ebatiluwane la batotina; ende wasi isosha shokikola baoi bana nda baoi ebaluwani.
english: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

lokele: Nde Bolimo ko Ɔmwito nd’asokɔkɔlɛsɛ ebafaefi-ba batotina la Inde nd’asokaela bao ende boto la boto kwa asosang’Inde.
english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

lokele: Kwa ayali bindo ya oto ko imwito, ani bile la bilengo wike la kwa bilengo-bi ya bindo yende ya bindo imwito, ko ongoma Masiya la Etanda imɔ.
english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

lokele: Eoka mbo iso imɔ yaatotina tosolufiomo ko la Bolimo Ɔmwito ko la lilufi limɔi— la BaYuda la BaHela la bɛkɔwa la tootekwa bindo imwito la batotina basɔɔlɔ ko Bolimo ko Ɔmɔi.
english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

lokele: Bindo ya boto biti ko elengo ɛmɔi kongo, kanga wike.
english: For the body is not one member, but many.

lokele: Limɔ litindi lionga mbo— Iti bosamba, ongoma imi iti wa bindo; ko la lioi-li liitosɛnyana la bindo.
english: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

lokele: Litoi imɔ lionga mbo— Eoka imi iti liso, ongoma imi iti wa bindo; nde ko la lioi-li liitosɛnyana la bindo.
english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo bindo bitotina biyala ngo ko liso, lioki lia litoi anima to? ¿Eya to mbo bindo bitotina biyala ngo ko lioki lia litoi, ani lümbo loa bowase anima to?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

lokele: Kongo ko Mungu nd’asota bilengo nda bindo, ɛmɔi l’ɛmɔi kwa asangak’Inde;
english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo bitotina biyala ko elengo ɛmwito, ani bindo angɛnɛ anima to?
english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

lokele: Nde tɛnɛngo, bilengo wike, nde bindo ko ɛmɔi.
english: But now they are many members, but one body.

lokele: Ongoma liso litikɔkɔlɛ ndoonga la bosamba mbo— Iti la boeno waɛ! La botö imɔ angoonga la batindi mbo— Iti la boeno wanu!
english: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

lokele: Ongoma efinole, nde bilengo ebisotangomo ko bilɛli, yao bitikɔkɔlɛ ndoomelo nda bindo,
english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

lokele: la bilengo ebititang’iso mbo ebilitesomu, yao totowatesa bisinda ya bɔfɛkɔ, nde yao ebitowaka lasu limama, yao bisofomo loliteso eloeta.
english: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

lokele: Nde ebile la bɔfɛkɔ biti la boeno wa bɔfɛkɔ wasi. Eingo ko, Mungu asokomya bindo yasu la wɛlï la asofaefa ebisolengeela loliteso ko kotalia wa loliteso,
english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

lokele: mbo bindo bitaatakana ndowesabana, kangä mbo bilengo bisangeke ko ndokukiana la bolau.
english: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

lokele: Ango elengo ɛmɔi eoka wäle, ambo bilengo eitotina imɔ kooka wäle amamwito la yao; elengo ɛmɔi blitesomo la bɔfɛkɔ, ambo bitotina imɔ kooka limɛngɔ amamwito la yao.
english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

lokele: Ino wende to bindo ya Masiya, ɔmɔi la ɔmɔi ko bilengo ya bindo yande.
english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

lokele: Nda Etanda Mungu asotaka bilengo biko, eba oso Batomomu, limɔ Batɔndɔli, limɔ Baekesi, limɔ ebatokela bisisho, limɔ ebasofomo bofoka wouwekesa eba ngwo, ebasofomo isosha shosungaka basi, isosha sha bekumi, la wɛlï woonga baoi ebatiluane la batotina.
english: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

lokele: ¿Mbo batotina bende Batomomu, batotina Batɔndɔli, mbo batotina Baekesi, batotina batokelaka bisisho,
english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

lokele: batotina basofomo wɛlï wouwekesa eba ngwo, batotina batoonga baoi ebatiluwane, batotina batosanola batina ba baoi ana?
english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

lokele: Talolaka nde bafi ba Bolimo ebalongeli. Nde itotamb’ino mboka yoiyela boyaeli ewetela.
english: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

lokele: Ango yelonga ndoonga la baoi batotina ba bato, angoko eba Bakitomo, nde angwɛnɛ losamɔ, ambo yende kwa elundi ya liuti, kwa tonjinjei kongo.
english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

lokele: Ango yefomo isosha shota loka, yeluwa njasɔ bitotina ebiisami la wɛlï bototina, yeyala la liimeli lioeta elioumbola föngo angɛnɛ, nde angwɛnɛ losamɔ, ongoma yende ko wawa.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

lokele: Ango yefaefaka bato likaɔ lia yeka bitotina ebisoomana lami, yefaka ango bindo yami mbo bifechomoko, nde angwɛnɛ losamɔ, ongoma itiafote ango shaya.
english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

lokele: Losamɔ lole la liumbakeli, lole la booto; loti la bɔmɛtɔ, losamɔ loti la ifaala;
english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

lokele: losamɔ loitotaka nganyä, lotifɔlɛ njasɔ ya sɔni, loitokota ndolongesa ko ebisolɛmb’inde angɛnɛ, loitosoma sasa, loti la bofëla eoka ya bɔfi.
english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

lokele: Losamɔ loitoomakala eoka ya yao ebitiengane, nde lotoomala la eya momongo.
english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

lokele: Losamɔ lototendela bobe, lotolendelo bitotina, lotokɛsɛkɛlɛ bitotina iyɛli silau, lotokɔkɔmɛlɛ ebiwau bitotina.
english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

lokele: Losamɔ lotilasɛɛsɛlɛkɛ; kongo ko linangoli nd’atomachomo, liongi lia baoi ebatiluwane litina nd’atosila, liluwani nd’atomachomo.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

lokele: Eoka liluwani liasu bato likaɔlwɛ la linangoli liasu litiiyele wewe;
english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

lokele: nde akayeke yao ebisɔɔlwa, limɔ ebitiiyele chaa, yao kosilasila fɛɛ.
english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

lokele: Ayalaka’mi wainɛngɛ yaongaka kwa wainɛngɛ, yaenyelaka kwa atoenyela wainɛngɛ, yakomyaka batina ba njasɔ kwa atokomya wainɛngɛ nda botema wande, kwani asoya’mi otolome oku, isotamacha biyaelo ya wainɛngɛ.
english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

lokele: Kwani to tosɔɛnɛ wenda kwa atɔɛnɛ boto wɛnɛ elimi nda wɛ̈li wa talatala la botufele, nde mbisa tolɛnɛkɛ sandelele la ɔmbɔ la ɔmbɔ. Kwani liluwani liami litiɔlwɛ, nde mbisa yeluwaka hɔlɔɔ imɔ kwa imi angɛnɛ isoluwomo hɔlɔɔ.
