english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ebitikali ngo ko ebisatɔ, biko liimeli la iyɛli la losamɔ, nde elosolongela lole ngo ko losamɔ.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

lokele: Fumbaka ndoosha losamɔ-lo la lolaka imɔ bafaefi ba Bolimo, nde simbi to mbo boyaleke Batɔndɔli;
english: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

lokele: eoka oyatonangola nda baoi ebatiluwane, ationge la bato kangä la Mungu; angwɛnɛ to boto boluwa litina lia lioi liande eoka ko la Bolimo asoonga njasɔ ebisoisomo ende bato.
english: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

lokele: Kongo ko oyatotɔndɔlɔ, asoonga la balomboki baoi bokɔkɔmɛsɛ la bofumbesa la bolatemesa betema yau.
english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

lokele: Oyatoonga la baoi ebatiluwane atokɔkɔmɛsɛ botema wande angɛnɛ, nde oyatotɔndɔlɔ atokɔkɔmɛsɛ Etanda.
english: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

lokele: Ilɛmbi nde ino yaatotina ndoonga la baoi ebatiluwane, kongo ko elosolongela finɛ lole mbo boyaleke Batɔndɔli. Oyatotɔndɔlɔ alongeli nde oyatoonga la baoi ebatiluwane, sakolo ngo ko boto kokikola baoi-ba mbo Etanda baɔlɛkɛ bokɔkɔmu ongoma.
english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

lokele: ¿Kongo ko, Bitungani yami, ango yeya end’ino ndoyaonga baoi bana, imi kɔɔlɛs’ino boni bolau ani itionge lanu baoi boisokola litina, kwa boluwes’ino loasɔ, kwa litɔndɔli, kwa liekesi?
english: But now, brothers, 14:6 if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

lokele: ¿Ongoma imɔ bofilingi la likwengu ebile ko yeka ebiti la liwawi, eyambo bitikusole limiki la limiki lia eliande kanda, ndai koluwa bɔɛlɛ kwa ewa bofiling kwa ewa likwengu?
english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo ifonge sha bita siyowana limiki, ndai kotonja biɛla yonana?
english: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

lokele: End’ino ko ongoma; ¿Eyambo boonga baoi ebatiluwane litina, bato koluwa ebiongomu la moni? Ani otoonga ngo ko la lofofo kongo.
english: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

lokele: Baoi ba kanda la kanda bayali nda wenda-bo, angwɛnɛ fee, angwɛnɛ eliti la eliande litina,
english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

lokele: nde ani itiluwe litina lia baoi-ba, yende ko boto boyowayowa nda baoi, la oyatoonga imɔ ale ko bɔɛnda ende’mi.
english: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

lokele: End’ino ko ongoma; bolola bafaefi ba Bolimo, fumbaka ndolongela ko ndokɔkɔmɛsɛ Etanda kɔkɛ.
english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

lokele: Eokao oyatoonga la baoi ebatiluwane, atasombolaka mbo afomoko imɔ ko bofoka wokikola baoi-ao;
english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

lokele: eoka yesombola la baoi ebatiluwane, bolimo wami nd’atosombola, nde botema wami botiluwe litina.
english: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

lokele: ¿Loasɔ lole to moni? Itosombola la bolimo, itosombola imɔ ko la botema wami; itochwa bɔɛlɛ la bolimo, itochwa ko la botema imɔ.
english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

lokele: Ango bofaefa Mungu kelekele ko la bolimo, limɔ boto wasi oyati la fofe yoluwa litina, inde koaola Ongoma mbisa ya lisomboli liaɛ lia kelekele? Eoka boto ona atiluwe elitoonga aɛ.
english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

lokele: Ambo osoonga kelekele la olau finɛ, nde boto wasi ona atikɔkɔmɛsɔmɔ ongoma.
english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

lokele: Isofaefa Mungu kelekele eoka mbo imi nd’asoonga la baoi bana, bolongel’ino yaatotina;
english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

lokele: kongo ko ende’mi, isotalɛmbɛ ndoonga baoi bɔɔmwi boluwana litina nda Etanda, mbo bato basi imɔ baekesomoko, inga ndoonga baoi bilɛfu liu ebatiluwane litina la wɛlï.
english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

lokele: Bitungani yami, oyalëke kwa bana’oli nda baenyeli banu; kongo ko nda njasɔ ibe yalaka bana’oli, nde nda baenyeli banu yalaka ko batowange baoku.
english: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

lokele: Lososɔnɔmɔ nda Lokasa loa Bikela mbo— Itoonga la tukelaye ya bato ko la baoi ebatiluwane lau La ko la bɛnɔkɔ ya beenda, kongo ko baitokaka’mi, Mungu nd’aongaka ongoma.
english: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.” Isaiah 28:11-12

lokele: Ongoma to, Bolimo asof’iso baoi ebatiluwane kwa ndembe end’iyo ebatiimele inga eoka ebasoimela kongo ko litɔndɔli liti eoka ya ebatiimele, kangä ebasoimela Lioi lia Ngɛnɛ.
english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

lokele: ¿Atosɔngɔmɔ to Etanda nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ; eyambo batotina beongaka la baoi ebatiluwane, atɔɔtɔkɔ ebatiluwesomo njasɔ yanu l’ebatiimele, iyo baitoonga mbo bosowa loseka?
english: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

lokele: Kongo ko eyambo batotina bɛtɔndɔlɔ, ɔmɔi l’ɔmɔi, limɔ oyatiimele angoko wembela wa oto ɛɔtɔ, atotombolomo njasɔ ibe yande ko lanu, atolembeela obe wande,
english: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

lokele: la ebiisami nda botema wande bitoisolomo, limɔ atotulia bɔmbɔ se, atoinela Mungu la atoaola fololo mbo— Wewe, Mungu ale sisi yanu. Likomyi lia bosemoeli wa Mungu
english: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

lokele: ¿Bitungani yami, loasɔ lole to moni? Tɛnɛngo, atosɔngɔkɔmɔ ino, ɔmɔi ale la bɔɛlɛ, wasi ale la linangoli lia litina, wasi atoisola loasɔ lowau, wasi atoonga la baoi ebatiluwane litina, wasi atokikola lioi lina; nde bolau mbo bitotina bikelomoko ko mbo Etanda ekɔkɔmɛsɔmɔkɔ kɔkɛ.
english: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

lokele: Eyambo boto eonga la baoi ebatiluwane, ambo ambale ango ko basatɔ kongo, angoetela; baongeke la lisho, limɔ wasi akikoleke baoi.
english: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

lokele: Nde eya to mbo angwɛnɛ ikɔmi shokikola baoi, limɔ oyatoonga baoi ebatiluwane ayaleke ngo ko tau nda lisɔngɔmi lia Etanda, aongeke ko inde angɛnɛ la Mungu.
english: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

lokele: Ebatotɔndɔlɔ baongeke kwa ambale, kwa asatɔ, limɔ ebamɔi balembeeleke litina kwa ayali liao.
english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

lokele: Nde eyambo Bolimo boisoela boto oyali se loasɔ lɔmɔi, limɔ oyasoonga oso koyala tau.
english: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

lokele: Ongoma to batotina batokɔkɔlɔ ndotɔndɔlɔ, ɔmɔi la ɔmɔi mbo batotina baekesomoko la mbo batotina bafumbesomoko;
english: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

lokele: la belimo ya ebatotɔndɔlɔ bitokɔkɔlɔ ndotonjomo ko la batɔndɔli.
english: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

lokele: Eoka Mungu ati wa liyɛyɛ, kangä wa lilatemi, nda bitanda bitotina y’eba liimeli ko ongoma.
english: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

lokele: Batomali batayalaka tau nda lisɔngɔmi lia Etanda, eoka batimachomo ndoonga nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ, nde bakomiomoko kwa asoonga Bikela ya Mɔsɛ.
english: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says, Deuteronomy 27:9

lokele: Nde belɛmbɛ ndoluwesomo loasɔ lɔmɔi, bafeleke batolome bau angɛnɛ nda ndakɔ, eoka ende sɔni ende otomali ndoonga nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ.
english: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

lokele: ¿Mbo lioi lia Mungu lisoya ko lanu, kwa mbo lisoiyela ko ino kongo?
english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

lokele: Boto etanga nde mbo ale bɔtɔndɔli, ango ko mbo afomu nde Bolimo, aluweke ndolembeela baoi ebakosɔnɔ’mi end’ino mbo bende ekela ya Ngɛnɛ kongo.
english: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

lokele: Nde ango boto atiluwe ndolembeela liao, ambo inde angɛnɛ atilembeelomo.
english: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

lokele: Ongoma to, Bitungani yami, lolaka finɛ ndotɔndɔlɔ la okufesëke boto ndoonga baoi ebatiluwane;
english: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

lokele: kongo ko bitotina bikelomoko la wɛlï la likɔmɔnyi.
english: Let all things be done decently and in order.

lokele: Bitungani yami, ikoenyeles’ino Mboli Ilau ebisonangoela’mi ino, la ebisoael’ino, la ebisokɔkɔmɛlɛ imɔ lanu;
english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

lokele: osouwesomo ko la yao biko linangoli lia Mboli eyanangolaka’mi ino, bokɔchaka liao; aenaka ongoma ani bosoimela liimelela.
english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

lokele: Yafak’ino liölo-li lioeta, kwa afomoko imɔ ko’mi, liko mbo Masiya awaka eoka ya batwanelo basu, kwa asoonga Lokasa loa Mungu,
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

lokele: la mbo aombomoko nda kito la mbo atɛmwɛsɔmɔkɔ nda lise lia asatɔ, kwa asoonga Lokasa loa Mungu,
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

lokele: la mbo ɛnɔmɔkɔ̈ la Kefa, limɔ l’eba Liu la ambale.
english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

lokele: Mbisa Inde ɛnɔmɔkɔ̈ la beoto boeta mia bɔɔmwi nda lise limɔi, la wike wa beoto ina bakoyali konda eweuse, nde bamɔi bau basokwa ilɔ siko liwa.
english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

lokele: Mbisa ɛnɔmɔkɔ̈ la Yakobo, limɔ la Batomomu batotina.
english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

lokele: Limɔ liili lia yaatotina ɛnɔmɔkɔ̈ ende litaeli ambo ko imi.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

lokele: Eoka imi yende itungangɔlɔ sha Batomomu, im’itiöndo ndotangomo botomomu eoka yakongolaka Etanda ya Mungu.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

lokele: Nde ko la lifafu lia Mungu yende kwa ayali’mi oko kwani, la booto wa Mungu ende’mi botiyale wawa, kongo ko isokuwaka la owau wolongela iyo yaatotina, nde ati to imi kangä booto wa Mungu amamwito lami.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

lokele: Eokao, kwa mbo ale ko imi kwa iyo ana, ongoma tosota boekï wa Mboli Ilau la ongoma ino nd’asoimela yao.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo inango sha litɛmwi lia Masiya sikonangokolomo, monito bamɔi banu batoonga mbo Litɛmwi nda liwa liti wewe?
english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

lokele: Eya mbo Litɛmwi lia ebawi liti wewe, ani Masiya atiakuswaka nda liwa;
english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

lokele: eya to mbo Masiya atiakuswaka ani linangoli liasu la liimeli lianu lile ko wawa.
english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

lokele: Ongoma to tosɔɛnɛlɛ kwa ebasoongela Mungu la lolanga eoka mbo tosokambekesa bato mbo Mungu nd’atɛmɔlɔkɔ Masiya nda liwa ani atiatɛmɔlɔk’Inde wewe, eya to mbo ende wewe mbo ebasowa baitotɛmɔlɔmɔkɔ.
english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

lokele: Eya to mbo ebasowa baitotɛmɔlɔmɔkɔ, ani Masiya atiakuswaka nda liwa;
english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

lokele: eya to mbo Masiya atiakuswaka, liimeli lianu lile ko wimelaimela la ino bokoyala nda batwanelo banu.
english: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

lokele: Ongoma to ebasokwa ilɔ sha liwa ani basolendelo Masiya, basosɛɛsɛlɛ!
english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

lokele: Eya to mbo tosokɛsɛkɛ tɔɛli mbo toyalaka la Masiya nda wenda-bo kongo, ani simbi to iso, twende bato bowɛlɔmɔkɔ ngandi ko la bato batotina!
english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

lokele: Efinole ina! Nde Masiya asotɛmwa ndotɛmwa nda liwa, ale oyasotakuswa oso w’ebasokwa ilɔ sha liwa.
english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

lokele: Eoka kwa ayaka liwa loasɔ loa boto, ongoma to litɛmwi nda liwa lisoya loasɔ loa Boto.
english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

lokele: Eoka kwa asowaka batotina loasɔ loa Adamu, ko ongoma imɔ batotina bewawesomoko liasi loasɔ loa Masiya.
english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

lokele: Nde tototɛmwa ɔmɔi la ɔmɔi tunya la tunya, Masiya asotola oso, limɔ eba Masiya nda mbile eyekayek’Inde liasi.
english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

lokele: Limɔ batungelo ani Inde asofa yakakaelo yande ende Mungu Sango l’ani asotombola likakalesi liasi la isosha shasi la bofoka wasi bototina tomboo.
english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

lokele: Eoka lole loande ndoyalaka Bɔkɔta kond’atosɛlɛ Mungu biyani bitotina yande ose ya batindi bande.
english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

lokele: Wiyani ewa liili wotombolomo bole ko Liwa;
english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

lokele: eoka asosɛlɛ bitotina ose ya batindi bande, kongo ko nda lioi liko mbo— Bitotina bisosɛlɔmɔ ose yande, ambo Inde asosakoelomo ako oyasosɛlɛ bitotina ose yande angɛnɛ.
english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” Psalms 8:6 But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

lokele: Limɔ ani bitotina bisosɛlɔmɔ ose yande, wana angɛnɛ atotulamel’Inde se oyasosɛlɛ bitotina ose yande, mbo Mungu aɔlwɛkɛ hɔlɔɔ nda wenda bototina.
english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

lokele: ¿Aenaka ongoma, monito bamɔi basolufiomo ko loasɔ loa ebasotawa oso? ¿Eya to mbo ebasowa angotɛmwa imɔ ango sinyo, monito basolufiomo loasɔ loau?
english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

lokele: ¿Iso imɔ tosoyala nda bifembi ya liwa lise la lise moni?
english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

lokele: Fufo! Bitungani, kwa asoomala’mi loasɔ loanu ende Yesu Masiya, im’isowa lise la lise.
english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

lokele: ¿Toenyela kwa asoenyela balomboki, ananaka’mi la nyama nda Efeso, boni bondanda ebole lami? Eya to mbo ebasowa angotɛmwa liasi, iso mbo— Toleke la tomweke eoka lɛlɛngɔ tosowa!
english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.” Isaiah 22:13

lokele: Nde olimbomöko to! Basaɔ babe basobebesa boyaeli bolau.
english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

lokele: Siswa wewe! Okelëk’imɔ batwanelo! Eoka bamɔi banu otiluwe Mungu ango sinyo, Isoonga ongoma ko ndokes’ino sɔni finɛ.
english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

lokele: Nde ɔmɔi atofela mbo— Ebasowa batotɛmwa liasi la moni? ¿Batoya la boni bɔfɔnɔ wa bindo?
english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

lokele: Wende to botutuku ako aɛ oyatolɔɔ lokoto nda elanga; elosolɔɔ aɛ loitoɔ̈tɔ̈ sakolo ko losotawa;
english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

lokele: la elosolɔɔ aɛ nda nyɛlɛ loti bindo eyekaɔ̈tɛkɛ kangä lokoto wasë, angoko loa bofonga ango ko loa yeka yasi.
english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

lokele: Ale nde Mungu oyatofa loao bindo kwa asosang’Inde, nda lokoto la lokoto ko bindo eyande angɛnɛ.
english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

lokele: Komba bitotina biti to la bɔfɔnɔ ɔmɔi, kongo ko biyali lokomba loa bato, l’eloa nyama, l’eloa nɔli, l’eloa swi.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

lokele: Bindo ya use la bindo ya nyɛlɛ bitisangane, nde bɔfɛkɔ wa eya use la bɔfɛkɔ wa eya se bitisangane;
english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

lokele: bɔfɛkɔ wa liso lia use la bɔfɛkɔ wa songe la bɔfɛkɔ wa tolonge bitwanani la bɔfɛkɔ wa ilonge la ilonge botisangane.
english: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

lokele: Boyaeli wa litɛmwi lia ebasowa bole ko ongoma. Bindo bisolɔɔmɔ kwa lokoto, bisolɔɔmɔ la liɔli nde bitotɛmwa angɔɔlɔ imɔ.
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

lokele: Bisolɔɔmɔ nda nyɛlɛ la bɔsɛnɔ nde bitotɛmwa la bɔfɛkɔ; bisolɔɔmɔ la ɔlɛmbu nde bitotɛmwa la bofoka.
english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

lokele: Bisolɔɔmɔ la bindo ya bolomboki, nde bitotɛmwa ko la bindo ya bolimo.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

lokele: Loasɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Bolomboki wa oso ako Adamu aaka boto wa liwawi; Adamu wa liili ende Bolimo Bofaefi wa loiko.
english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” Genesis 2:7 The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

lokele: Kongo ko eya bolimo etiaaka oso, kangä eya bolomboki limɔ eya bolimo mbisa.
english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

lokele: Boto wa oso losokwa nda nyɛlɛ ko ilɔngɔ, nde ewa mbisa asosokwa nda Use.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

lokele: Kwa ayalaka oyo wa ilɔngɔ, ko ongoma imɔ atoyalaka bana ba ilɔngɔ; la kwa ayalaka Oyo wa Use, ko ongoma imɔ atoyalaka bana ba Use.
english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

lokele: Kwa ayalak’iso la bɔfɔnɔ wa boto wa ilɔngɔ, ongoma tolayalaka imɔ la bɔfɔnɔ wa Boto wa Use.
english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s 15:49 also bear the image of the heavenly.

lokele: Bitungani yami, isokambes’ino mbo— Binjo la bakila bitikɔkɔlɛ ndosangola eyaelo nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu la liɔli litikɔkɔlɛ ndosangola eyaelo amamwito la ebatilaɔlɛk’imɔ.
english: Now I say this, brothers, 15:50 that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, isokambes’ino loasɔ elosotaisama loko mbo— Iso toitoingala tɔlɔ twa liwa iso yaatotina, kongo ko iso yaatotina tolakindolomoko la bɔfɔnɔ wasi,
english: Behold, 15:51 I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

lokele: nda mbile ko ɛkɛkɛ kwa libɛbyi lia liso, ani akaomeke ifonge sha liili. Ifonge silaomomoko nde, limɔ ebasowa belatɛmwaka angɔɔlɔ imɔ la iso ebatitaweke, iso tolakindolomoko la bɔfɔnɔ wasi.
english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

lokele: Lole ende bindo-bi ebitofɔndɔ mbo biwateke yasi ebiti yofɔndɔ imɔ la bindo-bi ebitosinga kowataka yasi ebitilaweke imɔ.
english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

lokele: Lamao akawateke bindo-bi owata yasi ebiti yofɔndɔ la akawateke bindo-bi eyetosinga ko yasi ebitilaweke imɔ, kwaamao lioi lia Lokasa loa Mungu lilakɔchɔmɔkɔ mbo— Liwa lisolindesomo ko la Lilongeli lia Masiya.
english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.” Isaiah 25:8

lokele: Ee Liwa! Lilongeli liaɛ anima to? Ee Liwa! Linyo liaɛ anima to?
english: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, 15:55 where is your victory?” See Hosea 13:14

lokele: Linyo lia Liwa liende ko Bobe, Isosha sha Bobe sile Bikela.
english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

lokele: Nde kelekele ende Mungu oyatofak’iso Lilongeli ko la Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya!
english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Eokao, Bitungani ebisamomu lami, kɔkɔmɛlɛkɛ, oeyaeyëk’imɔ, ɔlɔlɔkɔ likuwa lia Ngɛnɛ la boliliya, eoka osoluwa mbo likuwa lianu lia lotawo elitokelak’ino eoka ya Ngɛnɛ, litikelomo likeela.
english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

lokele: Nda loasɔ loa lifaefi liokɛsɔmɔ ende eba Etanda ebale la boeno, kwa asokambesa’mi okambesa bitanda ya Galatia, ino imɔ kelaka ko ongoma.
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

lokele: Lise lia oso lia yenga, boto la boto wanu, ücheke likaɔ lia bondanda ebosɔɔl’inde ndokukia liao mbo lifaefi litasɔnjɔkɔmɔ nda mbile eyekayeke’mi.
english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

lokele: Limɔ akayeke’mi end’ino, itotoma lifaefi lianu lia booto nda Yelusaleme ko la besamba ya bato ebatosɔn’ino baina nda lokasa.
english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

lokele: Eya to mbo loengana lami angɛnɛ ndɔkɛ la liao, limɔ iyo kɔkɛsɛnɛ amamwito lami. Mboli ya kɛndɔ ya Paulo
english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

lokele: Itoya end’ino fɛtɛti ani akaeteke’mi nda yese ya Makedonia eoka isosanga oeta nda Makedonia,
english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

lokele: nde eluwa imi koyala lanu sumbu, ango ko la tengai ya bɔfɛfyɔ, limɔ ino nd’atokɔkɔlɔ ndokatika’mi olo akaɛkɛ’mi.
english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

lokele: Itilɛmbɛ ndoya ko fɛtɛti kongo, nde Ngɛnɛ ekulia, iyɛli shami sile mbo itikaleke lanu mbile sumbu yumwa.
english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

lokele: Nde itoyalaka nda Efeso ko nda Elambɔ ya Pentekosete,
english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

lokele: eoka bome wa fofe ya likuwa bosoliolomo fololo oso wami, la ebalɛmbi ndokufesela’mi bende wike. Wɛndi la baseeli ende Bakuwani la Paulo
english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

lokele: Akayeke Timoteo end’ino, tinganaka mbo batawänges’inde ani atoyala inde lanu, eoka inde atokelaka likuwa lia Ngɛnɛ kwa atokelak’imɔ ko’mi.
english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

lokele: Eokao boto atasɛɔlɛk’inde, nde kɛsɛk’inde lɔkɛndɔ ko la lilatemi mbo ainyweke end’mi; eoka itotaumbakela inde amamwito la beoto ya Etanda.
english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

lokele: Nda loasɔ loa etungani yasu ako Apolo, isolɔmbɔkɔl’inde balɔmbɔkɔlɔ wike mbo ayeke amamwito la bitungani ebitoya end’ino, kongo ko atisangeke ndoya ko kwani, nde eyaka oko ani akɛnɛk’inde fofe.
english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

lokele: Lambaka bitungani, kɔkɔmɔkɔ nda liimeli, wangemaka la bofoka kwa batolome baoku!
english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

lokele: Nde bitotina yanu bikelomoko ko la losamɔ nda betema yanu.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

lokele: Oluwi nde bato ba bofindi wa Setefano mbo baaka eba Etanda ba oso nda Akaya, la mbo iyo angɛnɛ basoundaka likuwa liosungaka eba Etanda;
english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

lokele: la isolɔmbɔkɔl’ino bitungani mbo oliteseke bato ana la basi imɔ ba bɔfɔnɔ-bo la batotina ebatosungana lasu nda bakuwa bawau-ba.
english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

lokele: Yende la limɛngɔ finɛ mbo Setefana la Folotunato la Akaiko basoya eoka basosilesa boeno wami wɛnɛ ino,
english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

lokele: la basoyaimwesa to botema wami la eyanu betema lisanga; luwanaka to la bato ba bɔfɔnɔ-bo.
english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

lokele: Eba Bitanda nda Asia basoseel’ino la losamɔ loa Ngɛnɛ, la Akwila la Pulisika imɔ ko la bato b’Etanda ebatosɔngɔmɔ nda ndakɔ yau basoseel’ino.
english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

lokele: Bitungani bitotina ono batoseel’ino; lamolanaka la tɔchɔu etüchomu end’eba Etanda.
english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

lokele: Liseeli-li lisɔnɔmu la bosamba wami angɛnɛ ako Paulo.
english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

lokele: Eya to boto atisame Ngɛnɛ, oyo asendomoko! Ngɛnɛ wasu atoya!
english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. 16:22 Come, Lord! 16:22

lokele: Booto wa Ngɛnɛ wasu boyalakeke lanu!
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

lokele: Losamɔ loami loa Masiya loyaleke lanu batotina.
english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
